posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform How AI wiped out an entire industry in Nairobi The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • ChatGPT eliminated the academic paper-writing business model in Nairobi that catered to foreign students. • AI automation displaced an entire industry dependent on manual writing services. • African freelancers lost income as AI made their writing services obsolete and uncompetitive. 🤖 AI Platform Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver The Decoder · 🟣 Qwen · 3h ago • Alibaba's Qwen-Drive 1.0 combines environmental perception, traffic Q&A, and route planning for autonomous driving. • Text-image AI models fail to automatically understand three-dimensional space and spatial relationships. • Qwen-Drive provides explanations for braking decisions but they may not match actual maneuvers.
